name: browser-use
headline: Print on Demand Automation with Printify & Shopify
short_description: Automate your print on demand business with this integration of Printify, Stable Diffusion, and Shopify. Effortlessly create, optimize SEO, and upload custom images for your products, streamlining your e-commerce workflow.
author: IncomeStreamSurfer

sections.overview:
This skill automates print on demand workflows by integrating Printify, Stable Diffusion, and Shopify. It enables you to create custom product images, optimize them for SEO, and upload directly to your e-commerce store without manual intervention. The automation streamlines the entire process from image generation to product listing, reducing the time required to launch new designs.
Automatically generate product images for Shopify stores
Optimize SEO for print on demand products
Streamline the upload process for new designs
Integrate Stable Diffusion for unique artwork creation
sections.usage:
```
Automate my print-on-demand business by: 1) Generating [NUMBER] high-quality, on-trend designs using Stable Diffusion with the prompt '[PROMPT_DESCRIPTION]' and style '[ART_STYLE]', 2) Optimizing each design for SEO with keywords '[KEYWORDS]' and alt text '[ALT_TEXT]', 3) Uploading the optimized designs to Printify as [PRODUCT_TYPE] products (e.g., t-shirts, mugs) with mockups and pricing set to [PRICE_RANGE], and 4) Publishing the products to my Shopify store [STORE_NAME] with collections '[COLLECTIONS]' and tags '[TAGS]'. Ensure all images are in [IMAGE_FORMAT] and files are named '[NAMING_CONVENTION]'.
```
Copy

```
Here’s your automated workflow output for a new summer-themed t-shirt line:

**Design Generation:**
- Created 5 unique designs using Stable Diffusion with the prompt: "A vibrant tropical sunset with palm trees, retro 80s style, minimalist line art, bright neon colors" and style: "retro futurism, pop art, digital illustration".
- Generated files: `tropical_sunset_01.png` to `tropical_sunset_05.png` (1024x1024px, PNG).

**SEO Optimization:**
- Keywords: "tropical t-shirt, summer graphic tee, retro neon shirt, palm tree design, 80s style clothing".
- Alt text: "Retro 80s style tropical sunset palm tree graphic tee for summer wear".

**Printify Upload:**
- Product type: Unisex Premium T-Shirt (Gildan Softstyle 6000).
- Mockups: Generated and attached for front, back, and side views.
- Pricing: Set to $24.99 (base cost: $12.50, profit margin: 50%).
- Files uploaded to Printify with naming convention: `tropical_sunset_[01-05]_front.png`.

**Shopify Publishing:**
- Store: "Coastal Threads" (Shopify store ID: 123456789).
- Collections: "Summer Collection", "Tropical Vibes", "Graphic Tees".
- Tags: "summer, tropical, retro, graphic tee, unisex, casual".
- Product titles: "Retro Tropical Sunset Tee - [Design Name]" (e.g., "Retro Tropical Sunset Tee - Neon Palm").
- Descriptions: Auto-generated with SEO-optimized content and design details.

**Next Steps:**
1. Review the uploaded products in Printify for quality assurance.
2. Sync the Shopify products to ensure inventory and pricing are accurate.
3. Launch the new collection with a promotional post on Instagram and Facebook.

All files are ready for immediate use. Total time saved: ~2 hours per design set.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
